g.title: FigureResolution
g.text: Caption-grounded Figure resolution: local detection, parsing, and vision

g.title: input
g.text: PDF + requested Figure number or caption

g.title: fast
g.text: Exact number and local fast path enabled?

g.title: detector
g.text: find the numbered caption and nearby vector/raster region
accept only above the configured confidence threshold

g.title: local_figure
g.text: retain page, caption, bbox, confidence, and visual kind

g.title: cascade
g.text: profile locally -> route Marker / MinerU / PaddleOCR
retry transient errors within the total budget
then and only then fall back to local PyMuPDF

g.title: resolve
g.text: match Figure number first, then caption keyword
never use raw extraction order; exclude unlabeled logos/decorations

g.title: asset
g.text: Select higher-resolution asset + open local preview
retain page text, caption, and same-page tables when available

g.title: success
g.text: identity + page + caption + image + vision analysis + metadata

g.title: recovery
g.text: read the Figure page and following page, then report the boundary
